states.obligation: Catalogue/minimum litres are not maximum inventory. Model actual store/expansion/upper-pipe pressure, nonreturn and anti-vacuum states; the Lodge aperture does not bound this release.
Retire the original Plant-fed Utility cold link and exclude mixer crossconnection using actual independent air-gapped taps. No invented nonreturn protection.

Move PV to a separated dry Streethead occurrence; qualify actual mainboard seams, entries, heat and source-jet duty with the Utility door open. Source/store isolation is required before cabinet opening.
Prove simultaneous two-branch source curve, actual restriction Cd, full valves and network losses; no double allocation of one source.
A restriction does not reduce shut-in pressure; all pressure components still require the complete maximum pressure and transient envelope.
Actual low receiver, reverse sleeve, impact shield, support and wet seams still require joined proof.
Low entry containment does not catch the relocated house cut or upper joints. Replan the complete internal wet station; do not reuse the rejected tall cabinet.
Charge both flows independently. One receiving depression, obstruction or site flood cannot be credited twice.
The free-drop model is inapplicable; no pressure-backed or submerged outlet credit.
Finite storage is time to spill, not isolation. No manual response time is assigned.
Use full-bore source bound, tamper/effective-bore inspection and no bypass. A nameplate flow setting is insufficient.
Keep restriction immediately after the Lodge cut and all upstream joints outside the house. Public-side flow is not bounded by this aperture; independent provider action remains required.
Close own Lodge and house cuts; isolate/drain the upper trapped network and prove zero pressure. Keep sibling enclosure and supports independent.
Close Lodge/provider side as applicable and isolate/drain house side; support both pipe ends. Restriction removal temporarily destroys the flow bound; prohibit charging until verified reinstatement.
The prior permanent-pan and ordinary operator/tool/rest conflicts remain. New room geometry must prove both actual extraction directions or explicitly reject one with a complete ordinary alternative.

Restriction, Lodge, spool and room drains must stay serviceable through the declared cold event. Permanent open spill slots do not establish a warm enclosure; no trace heating, antifreeze or moving flap is invented.

washer.status: Retired product used as one native first-release comparator; not a procurement or material selection.

newMainboard.serviceState: Temporary service-suite closure. Before enclosure opening isolate source-fed water and cylinder/upper inventory, relieve and prove zero pressure; independently isolate utility AC and PV AC.

leaves.scope: Plain bronze pin-and-peg stay, positive closed catch and three butt hinges. Grip remains controlled through the complete 0–35 degree travel before the stay is seated. The two stay planes are staggered below the moving leaves.

purge.openingAreaMethod: England ADF Volume1,2021 Table1.4. A hinged opening of at least30 degrees uses opening area at least floor area/20. The selected stop is35 degrees. This is the nominal opening-area method; finite leaves still occupy part of the aperture plane.
purge.operation: Close the room door where its swing enters the task. Open the positive catches from the standing position. Hold each leaf through its full outward travel, then seat its bronze stay before releasing the grip. Reverse this sequence to close. Keep both stays controlled during handover.
purge.weather: Two-stage drained meeting rebates and cill. No inward-opening arched coupled sash or removable guard is inherited. The defined rectangular sash, hinges, catches, stays, seals, glazing and frame require joined wind, rain, cycle and whole-window Uw qualification.

visibility.proof: Both conservative complete portal boxes lie west of the shield and the target box lies east. Vertex extrema of the monotone interpolation fraction bound every segment-plane intersection. The finite shield covers those Y/Z bounds; raw and10mm setting reserves are separate. visibility.scope: Straight rays through either actual Utility or Plant portal, plus a source west of the shield inside the lobby. No pressure pipe is permitted inside the dry cupboard.

maintenance.normalState: All shield panels retained, board case closed, no water-bearing service in dry cupboard. Routine house water cuts remain in Utility.
maintenance.boardOpening: Temporarily close the service suite; isolate BOTH Lodge feeds and actual hot/store/upper inventory, drain and verify zero pressure; isolate utility AC and PV AC. Remove supported shield panels to a dry rest, then open the board from its retained1000mm work field.
maintenance.restoration: Close and inspect board, restore all shield/backing/receiving and fire boundaries, verify electrical and water systems, then restore occupied use.
